invariants.rule: Existing Git and todo history is immutable except through new ordinary forward commits and ordinary todo events.
Todo Orchestrator SQLite and WorkflowKernel are the sole workflow mutation authority.
No Project Control component may invoke another MCP server to implement a Project Control tool.
The observer profile exposes no workflow mutation tool and cannot dispatch one by name.
Profile selection is trusted startup configuration, never clientInfo or a request argument.
The current fifteen observer tools retain their accepted calls and meanings.
Codex begins with the bounded workflow protocol; rich reads are secondary.
Workflow transactions, claims, scheduling, capabilities, completion, and recovery are never reimplemented in Project Control.
Project Control fails closed on missing, skewed, or rebound Todo runtime identity.
The old installed service and registration remain restorable until final validated cutover.
No downstream engineering repository is modified by Project Control tasks.
No credential, tunnel secret, raw capability, or approval token enters source, evidence, logs, or todo projections.
